name: file-size-guard
description: Blocks oversized Java and MyBatis mapper XML before they are committed: a new file may not exceed 800 lines under src/main or 1200 under src/test, and a baselined file may shrink or stay but never grow. Enable or disable it as a plugin.

description_i18n.en: Blocks oversized Java and MyBatis mapper XML before commit. New files: 800 lines (src/main) / 1200 lines (src/test). Baselined files may shrink, never grow.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 提交前拦截过大的 Java 与 MyBatis Mapper XML：新文件 src/main 限 800 行、src/test 限 1200 行；基线内文件只许变小、不许再长。以插件开关控制启停。

baseline_path.description: 可选：基线文件路径（每行 <相对路径><TAB><行数>）。留空则使用项目根目录的 .file-size-baseline。

limit_main.description: src/main 下 Java / Mapper XML 的行数上限。

limit_test.description: src/test 下测试类的行数上限。
